notes.title: UI Update
notes.notes:
May 15th, 2025
⚙ Changes
🛠 Fixes
💙 Buffs
💔 Nerfs

⚙ General Changes

🛠 Fixed bug where menus that weren't supposed to allow scrolling would still scroll if you used keyboard or controller controls
🛠 Fixed mistake where "Quit to menu" option said "Exit to main"
⚙ Removed "Reduced Motion" option because its effects have been implemented into the main game
⚙ Redesigned color select
⚙ Removed "Press Start" and "Join Game" text from main menu


Character Select

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/4a09a12a2015b6ca5ad5ff448e34692e16f00513.png

⚙ Redesigned character select screen
⚙ Added playstyle indicator


Stage Select

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/30781dfeb9bd5aac546fcffb66b2dd6138584642.png

⚙ Redesigned stage select (now with mouse support)


In Game UI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/90a24f7781e838718221263989e3fa4d8cb10c5c.png

⚙ Redesigned in-game health and meter UI
⚙ Redesigned combo counter
⚙ Redesigned style ranks to match new combo counter
⚙ Changed burst indicator to be a square icon
⚙ Added icons that show your special moves and what directional inputs you need to perform them
⚙ Updated character portraits for Cyanide and Mercury to be higher resolution


⚙ New Mods

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/320c4495ce13cd3090beb3023b4eeec35b5521c9.png

⚙ Improved mod support
⚙ Added mods menu


Light Colors

Makes all of the colors lighter and less saturated. Looks less pretty but might be a bit less hard on the eyes.

Dual Cyanide Menu Background

Changes the background of the menu to be Cyanide drawn by Dual Drawn.

Metallic Names

Returns the nametags to their shiny metallic style that they used to have in previous updates.

Ability Names

Displays the name of each ability underneath its icon.

WARNING
If you want to make a mod for the game, do not create it inside the game folder. Anything in the game's folder will be deleted when you update.


TIP
Instead, make the mod folder somewhere else on your computer, and then add its filepath to the "Mods.txt" in the game folder. Then you can go into the game and enable it from the mods menu.


WARNING
Some mod effects might require you to restart your game for them to take effect.


⚙ Gallery

⚙ Added new gallery image by MattTheGamer172


⚙ Cyanide

⚙ Re-animated some of Cyanide's attacks.
⚙ The newly-changed attacks each now hit 3 times.


⚙ Mercury

⚙ Mercury has a new Reverse Damage Falloff mechanic that's unique to him.


💝 Special Thanks

SpadeInTheDirt for introducing me to Overwatch 2 which finally made me decide to add the ability icons.


⚠ Looking for feedback on

Everything


[!warning]
This update might come with performance issues. These will be fixed in due time.

notes.title: The Art Update
notes.notes:
⚙ Changes
🛠 Fixes
💙 Buffs
💔 Nerfs
⚙ General Changes.

 ⚙ Updated Steam images.
 ⚙ Added Fanart Gallery.
 ⚙ Strengthened bloom effect.
 ⚙ Dashing during a combo will now perform a homing dash.
 ⚙ Reduced camera shake on heavy attacks.
 ⚙ Reduced length of impact frames.
 ⚙ You can now double jump while ascending.
 ⚙ Volume level now defaults to "quiet".
 ⚙ Updated tab guide.
 ⚙ Increased ground bounce and knockdown time from 0.5 seconds to 1 second.
 ⚙ Improved gamepad controls in game.
 ⚙ Improved gamepad controls in menu.
 ⚙ Improved keyboard controls in menu.
 ⚙ Cursor now fades out after not being moved for a short time.

🛠 Bug Fixes

 🛠 Fixed Fanart Gallery
 🛠 Fixed character portraits
 🛠 Fixed a glitch allowing players to perform infinite double jumps while cancelling out of moves.

⚙ Cyanide

 ⚙ Updated portrait
 💙 Mercury now has 1 double jump. (instead of 0)
 💙 Mercury's ground combo now moves him forward making it easier to combo together.
 💙 The 3rd hit of Mercury's ground combo is now heavy and does more knockback.
 💙 Mercury's forward air is now heavy and does more knockback.

⚙ Mercury

 ⚙ Updated portrait
 💙 Added forward velocity to Cyanide's neutral air combo and down air making it easier to combo into.
 💙 Cyanide's forward air is now heavy and does more knockback.
 💙 3rd hit of Cyanide's ground combo is now heavy and does more knockback.
 💙 Down air is now a heavy attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/962efa4eaba47f1ee02d172415f8ea7022f4876b.png
- Owen CMYK, see you all next time!

notes.title: Mercury Pulls Update
notes.notes:
⚙ Changes
🛠 Fixes
💙 Buffs
💔 Nerfs
⚙ General Changes

 ⚙ Added camera tilt too all heavy attacks.
 ⚙ Increased hitstop on heavy attacks.
 ⚙ Decreased hitstop on light attacks.
 ⚙ Enter for Taunt and Escape for Pause have been seperated
 ⚙ Pausing is now instant.

🛠 Bug Fixes

 🛠 Fixed white square appearing when selecting stage.
 🛠 Fixed bug where assists would appear when playing regular versus mode.
 🛠 Remaining lives indicator now works properly.

⚙ Cyanide

 ⚙ Removed impact frames on Cyanide's Blood Rush transformation.
 🛠 Increased hitbox accuracy on Cyanide's idle animation and secret idle animation to account for her 
having a lot of curves that hitboxes don't represent well.
💙 Mercury

 🛠 Fixed hitbox inaccuracy on Mercury's neutral special. Thanks to CGF for noticing this.
 💙 Mercury's neutral special now pulls his opponents toward him.
